total_funding_usd.quote: Baseten raised a $1.5B Series F and achieved a $13B valuation

last_round.quote: we are thrilled to announce Baseten's $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital, co-led by Sands Capital and Wellington Management, with participation from Battery Ventures, Blackbird, D.E. Shaw Ventures, Durable Capital Partners, Greylock, IVP, Verified Capital, and 01A.

note: Baseten (founded 2019, CEO Tuhin Srivastava) is an independent AI inference-cloud startup, not a YC company (ycombinator.com/companies/baseten returns 404 — hint rejected). Rapid raise cadence: Series B $40M (Mar 2024, IVP+Spark led, Greylock/South Park Commons/Lachy Groom/Base Case participated) -> Series C $75M at $825M valuation (Feb 2025, per company Twitter) -> Series D $150M at $2.15B valuation (Sep 2025, Fortune) -> Nvidia $150M strategic investment (Jan 2026, WSJ) -> Series F $1.5B at $13B valuation (Jun 2026, company blog, 'fourth fundraise in 18 months'). Also acquihired Inferless (Feb 2026). Separately, a security researcher (Strix) reported gaining admin access to a Baseten production GitHub org in Sep 2026 — a notable security incident buyers should be aware of.
